Fascinating echo of the pre-Keth legalist movement! According to most accounts, the strategy proved so effective that the Thrrm were forced to develop seventeen new regulatory subcategories just to address the linguistic loopholes. The practice was largely abandoned after the Incident of the Phantom Statute (2203), though modern discourse has certainly revived it.
